## Institutional Alignment

SSCCS is an independent, non-profit foundation, accountable to no state, party, or corporation, releasing all work under Apache 2.0. It operates on the principle that has guided CERN since its founding: science is a public good, and it advances fastest when knowledge remains open.

The proposed collaboration stays within CERN's stated direction: "unleash the potential of open source for scientific and technological progress beyond high-energy physics." SSCCS works precisely in that domain: open hardware on RISC-V, structural computing primitives in the Tagma coordinate space, and exhaustive verification tooling in ExaVerif.

## What SSCCS Brings

| Asset | Relevance |
| :--- | :--- |
| ExaVerif (exhaustive RISC-V verification, 33.5M encodings evaluated) | Exhaustive, deterministic verification for RISC-V and radiation-tolerant systems |
| Chton (zero-serialization IO materialization) | Storage format equals the memory layout; the read path has no serialization step |
| Tagma (hash-less coordinate space; decoder estimated at ~300 gates) | Direct coordinate addressing with a minimal decoder, suited to low-power and constrained environments |
| Apache 2.0 release | Unencumbered integration with open-hardware ecosystems |

## A starting point: The ROOT TTree I/O Bottleneck

### The Problem

Production analysis in high-energy physics has a documented pain point: [ROOT TTree I/O](https://github.com/root-project/root/tree/master/tree/tree/src). In the CMS Re-miniAOD workflow, 372,000 singular read requests totaling 1.6 GB took 14 hours to serve, an average of 33 KB/s [CCESOP slides](https://indico.fnal.gov/event/69256/contributions/314511/attachments/187369/258396/20250423-CCESOP_SlowIO.pdf), with AOD files fully split into 8,190 branches. CERN is already investing in faster I/O, including RNTuple; the structural cost remains: every read still walks branches and deserializes.

### The SSCCS Approach

For structurally addressable data, SSCCS replaces the read path with coordinate addressing. An event becomes a coordinate: (run, luminosity block, event number) resolves to a direct offset, with no branch table, no index scan, and no hash. Chton materializes the coordinate space onto media with the storage format equal to the memory layout, and filters become spatial operations over coordinate ranges.

### The Offer to CERN

ROOT's I/O interface stays exactly as it is. Researchers keep the TTree API they already know, and their existing analysis scripts run unchanged. Inside, mapped data would be served from Chton's coordinate space instead of the disk. This is the disruptive innovation SSCCS proposes, with the disruption invisible to the researcher: the ecosystem is not broken, only the interior is replaced, and researchers have nothing new to learn.

### Proposed Demonstration

We propose a bounded demonstration on CMS Open Data 2016 (MiniAOD) that reproduces the documented access pattern and reports the comparison against the ROOT baseline. Its purpose is to establish the collaboration on the basis of a working result: the approach demonstrated on CERN's own access pattern, without disturbing its ecosystem. The engineering details, boundaries, and milestones are in the [ROOT-TTree](solution_proposals/root_ttree.html), and the demonstration builds against a maintained [ROOT fork](https://github.com/ssccsorg/root).
